ACT_1 opens at 14.310 (VC-0005) and ends 349.246; ACT_2 351.046 to 581.090 (VC-0076, 48 chunks); ACT_3 582.890 to 885.288 (VC-0124, 61 chunks); ACT_4 887.088 to 1488.012 (VC-0185, 102 chunks); ENDING 1489.812 to 1545.614 (VC-0287, 10 chunks). Not estimated. The hook is four sentences and runs longer than EP83's 8.773 because the fourth line is the question the film is built on; the number is what the voice actually did.
_declared_values.section_durations: HOOK 12.510 s / ACT_1 334.936 s / ACT_2 230.044 s / ACT_3 302.398 s / ACT_4 600.924 s / ENDING 55.802 s. Card counts were set from these durations, not from a constant: ACT_2 is the shortest act and carries 14 cards (one per 16.4 s), ACT_4 is the longest and carries 17 (one per 35.3 s). Every act is inside episode_spec's figure_beats_per_act [13, 17], which check_episode_inputs enforces as a floor of 13.
_declared_values.runtime_deviation: The narration measures 1545.618 s against episode_spec's declared runtime_seconds band of [1740, 2100] -- 194 s under the floor -- and the script is under the declared word band. BOTH ARE ALREADY ACCEPTED by the owner in approvals/APR-0001.json. Nothing in this config pads a section, stretches a hold or repeats a beat to close that gap, and no declared value in episode_spec was lowered to make it green.
_declared_values.not_yet_on_disk: `assets` and `captions` name the files the staging and caption steps will write (asset_manifest.v003.json, captions.final.v001.srt). Neither exists yet, which is the same state EP78-EP83 were in when their filmconfigs were authored -- the config declares the contract, the later step fills it. 06_audio/narration_index.v001.json and remotion/public/threemile/narration.mp3 (1545.618 s) DO exist and were read for this file, as did the 181 reviewed plates in remotion/public/threemile/img/ (5 rejected plates are in img/rejected/ and are not referenced here).
_declared_values.figures_by_section: Authored 2026-08-28 from 03_script/script.en.v001.md and episodes/_planning/EP84_threemile_FACTS_LEDGER.v001.md. Counts are 17/14/16/17 across ACT_1..ACT_4, HOOK 2 and ENDING 2; 68 cards in total. EVERY number on a card is a number the narration speaks -- 97, 8, 13, 32000, 1000, 100, 12, 1, 4, 11, 45000, 1000000 and 20 all appear in the script -- and every `stat` `value` is a NUMBER, so nothing can render as NaN. No `stat` carries a `group` key: the FigureSpec union gives `group` to `numberticker` only, and this config uses no numberticker.
_declared_values.ranges_are_never_stats: Every range is drawn as a kinetic pair or a comparison, never squeezed into one number card: the thousand-gallons-a-minute injection against the under-a-hundred throttle-back is a compbars row (TM-409, quoted figures only -- the throttle-back INTERVAL is OCR-corrupted in TM-409 and appears nowhere); the one-to-two-billion damage estimate is a kinetic line beside the fine (TM-714); the three-to-four-thousand-degree core temperature and the three-to-four rem worker doses are carried by the narration and are not drawn at all; the guilty/no-contest/dismissed split is a compbars row of three counts (TM-301, TM-302, TM-303).
_declared_values.no_OP_section: episode_spec's section_vocabulary lists OP, but narration_index has no OP chunks -- the brand opening is an overlay on the HOOK, not a spoken section. A card there would have no window to live in. episode_spec's ae_beats AE003 is an OP title card and is an After Effects job, not a figure beat; it is unaffected by this file.
_declared_values.quarantine: Read against episode_spec's forbidden_claims, one by one. (1) No card says anybody died or was made ill; the only health card carries the Commission's finding and its caveat ON THE SAME CARD, so TM-703 can never appear without TM-704 (they are the two lines of one kinetic beat). (2) No card connects the leak-rate count to the accident: the ACT_3 card states that the charge ENDS on 28 March 1979 and does not reach into it (TM-203), which is the opposite of a causal claim. (3) No card says the company was convicted of falsifying records or of any Title 18 offence -- the ACT_4 cards say Count 11 was dismissed, that it was the only count under Title 18, and that the company was never convicted of lying to the regulator (TM-205, TM-305, script:248). (4) No card calls the million a fine; two cards say the opposite (TM-311). The fine card says $45,000 (TM-304). (5) No card mentions the separate individual case, and no individual is named or depicted anywhere in this config. (6) No card blames the operators: the ACT_2 quote is the Commission's 'product of his training' finding (TM-415) and the ACT_4 quote is 'people-related problems' with 'the human beings ... constitute an important safety system' beside it (TM-603, TM-605). (7) The 3,300 person-rem figure appears on no card; no person-rem figure is drawn at all. (8) No reactor-order or cancellation statistic appears (TM-807). (9) The advisory card says 'AN ADVISORY, NOT AN EVACUATION' and names the two populations and the five-mile ring (TM-709). (10) Neither OCR-corrupted figure is on a card: TM-409's throttle-back interval is absent (only the two verbatim flow figures are drawn) and TM-505's printer lag is absent entirely -- there is no printer card. No card carries a company mark, a utility name, a readable document or a legible screen.
_declared_values.figure_anchoring: 2026-09-07. All 63 non-structural cards now carry `at_seconds`/`hold_seconds` read off 08_edit/captions.final.v001.srt: each card lands 0.3-0.8 s after the cue that speaks its own words, and every caption inside each card's window was read before the time was fixed. Within each section the times ascend and no two windows overlap (FigureBeats gives every beat its own Sequence, so overlapping beats would draw on top of each other). THREE ARRAY REORDERS, because the authored order contradicted the narration order and cards may never run backwards: (1) ACT_1 'NOT A NUCLEAR PROBLEM / A PLUMBING PROBLEM' moved ahead of the 28 MARCH 1979 card -- the plumbing line is spoken at 14.310, the date at 23.755; (2) ACT_1 the Commission conditional quote ('or if they had simply left on the plant's high pressure injection pumps') moved ahead of the TWO HOURS AND TWENTY-TWO MINUTES card -- the quote is spoken at 149.8, the 'water was leaving / panel said it was not' line at 162.3; (3) ACT_4 the 20 MILES card moved ahead of 'THAT MILLION WAS NOT A FINE' -- the twenty-mile ring is spoken at 1010.5, 'not a fine' at 1015.7. TWO AUTO-ANCHORS CORRECTED: the ACT_2 card 'ONE HUNDRED. IN MINUTES.' had been word-matched to 1507.712, which is the ENDING's recap of the same words and 926 s outside ACT_2's own window (351.046-581.090); it is now 386.800, on 'concentrate on the significant alarms. One hundred.' / 'In minutes. With nothing to sort them.' And the ACT_1 conditional quote had been matched forward to 196.077, over 'the high-pressure injection pumps started by themselves', 46 s past its own words; it is now 150.400. UNANCHORED BY DESIGN: the four act titles and the AI-disclosure lower third. build_figures drops a lone unpinned payload at its section MIDPOINT, which for these lands at ACT_1 177.0 (over the emergency-feedwater lights), ACT_2 461.3 (COLLIDES with the off-scale-instruments card at 457.9-464.4), ACT_3 729.3 (over the indictment's date range) and ACT_4 1182.8 (over 'were watching television'). Recommended pins, all in the gap before their act's first card: ACT ONE 14.4 hold 4.8, ACT TWO 351.4 hold 5.5, ACT THREE 583.5 hold 5.5, ACT FOUR 894.0 hold 6.0 (ACT_4 opens on its own dated first sentence, so its only clean gap is between the 29 FEBRUARY card and the plea compbars); the disclosure at 0.2 hold 3.0. The disclosure's current midpoint (4.755) sits under the hook kinetic, which is harmless -- it draws top-left and build_figures merges it in place -- but 0.2 is cleaner.
_declared_values.act_4_selection: ACT_4 runs 601 seconds and carries the plea, the money, the advisory, the disagreement among officials, the health findings and the Commission's last word. The 17 cards are spaced across that whole span rather than clustered on the courtroom: the last four sit on TM-603, TM-605, TM-703/TM-704 and TM-607. The judge's $85,000-maximum reasoning (TM-312), the mistaken burst-of-radiation interpretation (TM-711), the mental-health finding (TM-707), INPO (TM-802, TM-803), the 1980 action plan (TM-804, TM-805) and public confidence (TM-806) are carried by the narration and by the description rather than by a card.
